integrity: The accompanying proof provides a finite transfer graph and exact characteristic-polynomial certificate; the two standalone programs are reproducible and no independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only labelled binary cyclic configurations under synchronous elementary Rule 54, for ring lengths at least three, are covered.
The all-size classification concerns least temporal periods dividing four; other eventual periods and attraction basins are not classified.
The accessible primary full text from 2014 was inspected for prior comparisons, but historical priority is not proven; another relevant thesis was available here only in abstract form.
Finite independent computation through ring length twenty supports but does not replace the exact graph-transfer and spectral proof.
title: Exact temporal-four orbit census and spectral growth for elementary cellular automaton Rule 54
